title: Which One: the Ordinals, Said and Written
label: ch:ru-ordinals
canDo: I can say first, second and third, build the ordinal of any number I can count to, and read and write an ordinal as a figure with its ending hyphenated on.

payoff.summary: Two forms outside the pattern, one adjective ending for everything above them, and the written 1-y whose letters after the hyphen are the agreement rather than decoration.
